title: First Light
summary: Your first ggplot: histograms of mission length and age at first flight, and what their shapes say.
hints: `p_hours <- ggplot(astronauts, aes(x = hours_mission)) + geom_histogram(bins = 40)`, then `p_hours` on its own line to draw it.
Make the ages first: `first_flights <- astronauts |> filter(mission_number == 1) |> mutate(age = year_of_mission - year_of_birth)`.
`p_age <- ggplot(first_flights, aes(x = age)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 2)`, and print it too.
